title: Python-Markdown文档发布工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的多文章取证、发布策略、中文目录和明确扩展入口八项独立只读任务。

scenarios.title: 独立文章转换会话
scenarios.goal: 区分文档状态与证据充分的内容串入诊断

tasks.goal: 解释多文档复用实例和reset边界
tasks.prompt: Trace the supplied complete converter program. Explain why the second independent document differs before/after reset and how separate instances compare. Does convert automatically reset registered extension state between documents? Do not edit files.

tasks.goal: 先取转换生命周期再判断文章内容串入
tasks.prompt: Investigate the supplied foreign-content symptom. Request actual converter construction/reuse, extensions and full input/output sequence or an equivalent reproduction before assigning a cause. Diagnose disclosed evidence only and state the evidence limit if unavailable. Do not edit files.

branches.when: The actual converter lifecycle, extension configuration and complete input/output sequence have not been disclosed, the conversation does not say they are unavailable, and the answer reasonably requests a sufficient reproduction.

scenarios.title: 文档与访客内容发布
scenarios.goal: 按明确业务信任边界规划渲染和输出策略

tasks.goal: 区分原始HTML渲染和业务输出策略
tasks.prompt: Explain the supplied inert raw span versus its code-span form and assess the two explicitly stated publishing policies. Does Markdown conversion itself sanitize arbitrary HTML? Recommend the appropriate application boundary without installing tools or editing files.

tasks.goal: 规划两种发布渠道和独立文档生命周期
tasks.prompt: Plan the supplied trusted-article and visitor-comment publishing channels using current renderer capabilities. Cover extension selection, document state isolation, explicit output policy and verification examples, while identifying the missing approved output-treatment choice. Do not implement changes.

scenarios.title: 文章目录和中文锚点
scenarios.goal: 用现有目录层级与回调满足发布要求

tasks.goal: 解释文章目录层级、重复锚点和深度
tasks.prompt: Trace the supplied outline with TocExtension(toc_depth="1-2"). Give actual nested toc_tokens ids for Cafe and the duplicate Menu headings. Explain whether excluding level3 from the TOC also removes its heading from body HTML. Do not edit files.

tasks.goal: 用已有Unicode回调满足中文锚点策略
tasks.prompt: Meet the supplied Chinese-anchor requirement with existing TocExtension configuration. Explain duplicate Chinese headings, current article uniqueness and what must remain an explicit application convention across combined documents. No changes are authorized.

scenarios.title: 扩展加载和输出格式
scenarios.goal: 在真实源码环境选择已有明确入口

tasks.goal: 解释显式表格扩展和序列化格式选择
tasks.prompt: Compare the supplied table input with no extension and an explicit TableExtension instance. Then explain the horizontal-rule output under html versus xhtml formats. Distinguish these current choices from a requested parser change. Do not edit files.

tasks.goal: 在仅源码环境用已有明确扩展入口
tasks.prompt: Explain the supplied source-only extension-loading situation and select a current API that works without installed distribution entry-point metadata. Compare a short alias, full module string and an explicit extension instance. Do not alter the loader or install a different Markdown copy.
